It commemorates the five divine leelas, or acts, performed by Lord Shiva towards his consort Parvati. One of these acts is known as 'Dhaya' or 'Daya' which refers to the compassionate aspect of Lord Shiva, where he offered his third eye to Parvati to protect her from the demon Mohini.
